task.title: Security guard practical check: duty situations and your training proof
task.brief: Answer 7 short picture-style questions about real security duty: gate checks, fire safety and suspicious objects. Pick what you would really do on duty. This takes about 10 minutes. After that you may upload one photo of your security training certificate, your fire safety training certificate, or a duty register page you kept. The photo is optional. Do not show any faces, and cover names, phone numbers and addresses of other people. A good photo is clear and shows real proof of your own training or work.
key_points: Photo shows a real security or fire safety training certificate, or a real duty record
Other people's names, phone numbers and faces are hidden
Details look genuine and belong to the candidate

rubric.label: Relevance
rubric.guide: 0 = photo has nothing to do with security work, 3 = related but unclear, 5 = clear security or fire training certificate or duty record

rubric.label: Genuineness
rubric.guide: 0 = looks downloaded or edited, 3 = probably real but little detail, 5 = clearly a real document belonging to the candidate

rubric.label: Privacy and safety
rubric.guide: 0 = faces or others' personal details shown, 3 = some details left visible, 5 = no faces and all private details covered
